summary: Cycle to Zero is San Francisco AIDS Foundation's three-day ride from San Francisco to the Russian River and back. In 2027 it runs May 21–23: about 85 miles north through Marin to Guerneville, a day of riding from camp or a day off, then about 85 miles home down the Sonoma coast. Registration is $95 and the fundraising minimum is $2,500 for 3-day cyclists. Riders camp both nights in Guerneville.
history: AIDS/LifeCycle ran from San Francisco to Los Angeles for seven days every June and ended in 2025. San Francisco AIDS Foundation, one of its two producers, announced Cycle to Zero in September 2025 as a three-day ride that builds on that history.
The first Cycle to Zero was May 29–31, 2026, north to Guerneville and back. The name is the foundation's goal: zero new HIV diagnoses, zero stigma, zero inequity, zero overdose.
what_to_expect: Day 1 goes north from San Francisco through Marin County, past redwood forests, to Guerneville on the Russian River. It's about 85 miles.
Day 2 is yours. Let's Chill is about 40 miles and the Zero-Hero Century is about 100, both from Guerneville. You can also skip the bike for the foundation's activities or a day in town.

Camp is at Camp Russian River and Johnson's Beach in Guerneville, about a 15-minute walk apart, both nights. For 3-day cyclists the ride is fully supported, with all meals and camping included. Day 3 is about 85 miles back to San Francisco by the Sonoma coast.

faq.q: When is Cycle to Zero in 2027?
faq.a: May 21–23, 2027, a Friday through a Sunday. The 1-day ride is Saturday, May 22.

faq.q: What is the Cycle to Zero route?
faq.a: Day 1 is San Francisco to Guerneville, about 85 miles north through Marin County past redwood forests. Day 2 starts and ends in Guerneville: about 40 miles or about 100, or a day off. Day 3 is about 85 miles back to San Francisco by the Sonoma coast.
$2,500 for 3-day cyclists, due by May 1, 2027, with a $95 registration fee. 1-day cyclists pay $225 and have no minimum. Crew volunteers pay $95 and raise at least $250.
In camp in Guerneville, both nights, at Camp Russian River and Johnson's Beach. The two are about a 15-minute walk apart. Camping is included for 3-day cyclists.

faq.q: Can I ride just one day?
faq.a: Yes. 1-day cyclists ride Day 2, Saturday, May 22, from Guerneville. Registration is $225 and there is no fundraising minimum.
